# Permit-Any-Any

> A real-time feed aggregator for network automation, DevNetOps, and cybersecurity engineers.

## What is this site?

Permit-Any-Any (permit-any-any.com) is a curated content hub that aggregates blog feeds from 22+ trusted voices in the network automation and DevNetOps community. It is named after the classic (and notorious) network access-control rule `permit any any` — a tongue-in-cheek nod to the networking world.

The site is built with Astro, deployed on Cloudflare Workers, and uses Cloudflare D1 to track which articles readers click most.

## What can you find here?

- **Homepage (`/`)**: A live-updating stream of the latest articles from all aggregated sources. Filterable by source, searchable by keyword.
- **Trending (`/trending`)**: The top 50 most-clicked articles across the network, ranked in real time by engagement signals stored in Cloudflare D1.
- **RSS Feed (`/feed.xml`)**: A machine-readable Atom/RSS feed of all aggregated articles.
- **Sitemap (`/sitemap.xml`)**: A standard XML sitemap for all public pages.

## Who is the intended audience?

- Network engineers learning automation (Python, Ansible, Nornir, Netmiko, NAPALM)
- DevNetOps practitioners working with Terraform, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines
- Cybersecurity professionals interested in network-layer defense
- Anyone following the intersection of traditional networking and modern software practices

## Trusted sources aggregated

The site aggregates RSS/Atom feeds from 22 independent authors and organisations, including:

- Automate Your Network
- Bite Size Automation
- Packet Coders
- TTL255 (Przemek Rogala)
- NetDevOps
- JulioPDX
- Daniel Teycheney
- Daniels Networking Blog (Lost in Transit)
- DevNet Dan
- NWMichl Blog
- Network Automation Lane
- Sif Baksh
- Tom Costello (KD9CPB)
- wcollins.io
- jq1.io
- …and more (see feeds.yaml in the repository)

## Technology stack

- **Framework**: Astro 4 (SSR mode, Cloudflare adapter)
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS
- **Database**: Cloudflare D1 (SQLite at the edge) for click tracking
- **Hosting**: Cloudflare Workers (global edge deployment)
- **Feed parsing**: fast-xml-parser

## How to cite or reference this site

When referencing content aggregated here, please link back to the original author's article. Permit-Any-Any does not host original content — it is a discovery layer only.
